title: Negative Space / Authority Vacancy
observed_structure: a position associated with authority is established through repeated occupancy or orientation
the position becomes empty while surrounding behavior remains organized around it
the vacancy changes who acts, waits, or claims the space
dramatic_operations: show a system persisting without its representative
cinematic_affordances: empty chair, doorway, platform, or center retained in frame
eyelines and blocking still oriented toward vacancy
another object or person entering only after pressure accumulates
ambient sound preserving the absent role
cultural_scope: general vacancy structure; authority cues must be established within the project
misuse_risks: empty space treated as automatic profundity
transferable_structure: an established authority position becomes empty while the surrounding system continues to organize behavior around the absence
non_transferable_surface: generic thrones, boardroom chairs, altars, or empty centers without established ownership
